description: Search the Pali Canon on dhamma.gift by keyword/substring or REGEX (min 3 letters, no semantic search). Patterns like "kata.*dukkha", "vucc.*dukkha", "katha.*dukkha" find the canon's own definitions and expositions of a term. Returns a CENSUS of every matching sutta — id, title, match count, metaphor count, reader link — Pali only, ordered so that suttas that DEFINE the term come first, then ones NAMED after it, then by how often it occurs. Set include_segments for the matched Pali lines, include_translations (+ langs) for translations. 40 suttas by default (25 by occurrence count, plus 15 for suttas named after the term and ones defining it); metadata.totalFiles reports the true count, and limit takes a number or "all".

include_segments.description: Also return the matched Pali segments (segment id, text, reader link). Default: false — the census alone.

include_translations.description: Also return translations of the matched segments (implies include_segments). Default: false.

langs.description: Translation languages to include with include_translations, e.g. ["ru","en"]. Default: none (Pali only).

limit.description: How many suttas to list: a number, or "all" for every match. Default: 40, composed of 25 by occurrence count plus 15 for suttas named after the term and defining it. Strict — the cap means the cap. metadata.totalFiles always carries the true match count, so a truncated answer still tells you how much more there is. Suttas whose TITLE matches the query rank first within their collection.

query.description: Keyword, phrase, or REGEX pattern to search for (Pali or a translation word). Patterns work and are the way to find definitions: "kata.*dukkha" (Katamañca … dukkhaṁ?), "vucc.*dukkha" (idaṁ vuccati dukkhaṁ), "katha.*dukkha" (Kathañca … hoti?).

scope.description: default|all|dhamma|vinaya|abhi|khudakka|or comma-separated nikaya codes (dn,mn,...). Default: default (4 nikayas + 6 KN books).

translators.description: Explicit translator keys, e.g. ["en_sujato"] to include Sujato, or ["ru_sv"]. Needed only to override the default translator choice.

name: search
